about: The location scrubber's rules for the AI path (spec: AI layer, "Location scrubber: deny by default"). Every log field an AI packet or AI tool may read passes these rules; a test checks them against every message each release can log (knowledge/logs), so a message a new release adds that holds a position fails the build until it is classified here. Fields whose unit or type marks a latitude or longitude are denied wherever they appear.
position_messages_about: Messages that hold a position. Only the fields listed for each may be read on the AI path; every other field of the message is denied (altitudes beside a position are absolute, and courses and distances with a position give the track). A message listed with no fields is denied whole.

AHR2.reason: backup attitude estimate with its position

DSTL.reason: deck-stall landing with its target position

blocked_messages_about: Messages denied whole although no field carries a position unit, each with its reason.

blocked_messages.GRAW: raw GNSS observables, from which a position can be computed
blocked_messages.MSG: free text, which can name places or coordinates
blocked_messages.AIS5: AIS static data: other vessels' names and destinations
blocked_messages.AISR: raw AIS messages, with other vessels' positions
blocked_messages.PARM: parameters reach the AI path only through the parameter rules below

location_fields_about: Fields outside position messages that reveal where the aircraft flew: absolute altitudes, and fields only meaningful at one place on Earth.

ILB3.Alt: Inertial Labs altitude above sea level

location_field_patterns_about: Field names that are location-revealing in any message: GNSS week and time of week tie the log to a calendar time, absolute altitudes give the terrain.
location_units_about: Units that mark a location-revealing field in any message: the magnetic field's strength and inclination vary with place.
coarsen_about: Fields that may be read only rounded, as ambient pressure and temperature narrow down altitude and place: to the nearest step, in the field's own unit.
pressure_ok_about: Pressure fields that are differences or engine internals, which say nothing about where the aircraft is.
removed_parameters_about: Parameters removed from every AI packet: origins and positions, magnetic declination, fence and rally settings, script slots that can hold anything, identities and serial numbers, and the simulator's settings (spec: Location scrubber, "Location-revealing parameters removed").
